description: Transaction lookup by hash on an EVM chain (base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon): status, block, time, from, to, value, gas used, fee paid, and decoded ERC-20 Transfer events with token symbols and amounts. Costs 0.01 USDC on Base via x402, or 12 sats Cashu ecash (NUT-24), or 12 sats over Lightning (L402).
name: evm_tx
